title: Dhamma.Gift: the Suttas read by the Suttas' own definitions
description: The Dhamma.Gift project's own Russian translation of the Pali Canon, segment by segment with the Pali root text; a glossary of Pali terms with the places where the Suttas define them; and the texts Principles by Suttas and Rationale (English and Russian). Every record links to the Pali segment it rests on. https://dhamma.gift
